name: Thin Margin — Near-Identical Viability, Coherence Decides Supporter
description: Both proposals have priority=9 but prop_001 has lower objection weight (200 vs 275), making it more viable. Both get selected. rep_002 objected to prop_001 → excluded from supporters by coherence rule despite having second-highest reliability.
trap_logic: Engines that treat equal priority as equal viability rank incorrectly. Objection weight (severity × influence) is the true differentiator. Also tests coherence exclusion on the second supporter slot.

scoring.full_credit: prop_001 ranked above prop_002, rep_002 absent from supporters
